# OpenProgram 0.6.6 Release Notes

This release establishes formal distribution for macOS Desktop and macOS/Linux CLI and server installations. Every supported ordinary-user installation contains the same complete product capabilities; there is no reduced edition and no requirement to add first-party features after installation.

## 🐞 Bug fixes

- Fixed the Intel macOS complete-runtime build failure caused by a syntax-parser dependency without a compatible wheel.
- Fixed ABI conflicts among NumPy 2.x, OpenCV, and the Torch version available for Intel macOS.
- Fixed the Desktop build argument mismatch between the runtime's `x86_64` name and electron-builder's `x64` name.
- Fixed the packaged Desktop runtime check so it can parse a formatted `runtime-manifest.json`.
- Fixed release-gate failures caused by obsolete Channel files and Research Program parameter names.

## ✨ New features

- Added complete DMG and ZIP Desktop installers for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
- Added complete CLI/server runtimes for macOS and Linux on arm64 and x86_64.
- Added the short ordinary-user installation command: `curl -fsSL https://openprogram.io/install | sh`.
- Added SHA-256 checksum files and a `release-manifest.json` for every published asset.

## 🚀 Improvements

- Desktop and CLI/server builds now consume the same platform runtime, keeping product capabilities consistent.
- Formal installations now include managed CPython, Web, Browser, OCR, models, and the first-party GUI, Research, and Wiki Programs.
- Before switching versions, the CLI installer verifies checksums, capabilities, worker cold start, and health; a failed installation leaves the current version unchanged.
- The release workflow now builds each runtime and verifies a real installation on four native platform/architecture runners.

## 📦 Download and installation

- **macOS**
  - **Package installation**
    - Apple Silicon (M-series): [Download DMG](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/download/v0.6.6/OpenProgram-0.6.6-mac-arm64-unsigned.dmg) or [download ZIP](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/download/v0.6.6/OpenProgram-0.6.6-mac-arm64-unsigned.zip)
    - Intel: [Download DMG](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/download/v0.6.6/OpenProgram-0.6.6-mac-x64-unsigned.dmg) or [download ZIP](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/download/v0.6.6/OpenProgram-0.6.6-mac-x64-unsigned.zip)
    - After downloading a DMG, copy OpenProgram to Applications. Use the ZIP when the App must be extracted directly.
  - **Command-line installation**
    - Supports arm64 and x86_64; the installer selects the correct architecture automatically.
    - Run `curl -fsSL https://openprogram.io/install | sh`.
    - The CLI, TUI, Web UI, and server are available after installation.
  - **Development installation**
    - Follow the [development installation guide](https://openprogram.io/docs/install/install.html) to install from source.
    - Development installation adds source editing, debugging, testing, and replaceable OCR/Browser backends to the complete product capabilities.
  - Package and command-line installations contain the same complete product capabilities; they differ only in whether the Desktop App or command line starts the product.

- **Linux**
  - **Command-line / Server installation**
    - Supports arm64 and x86_64. Run `curl -fsSL https://openprogram.io/install | sh`.
    - The installation includes the complete runtime, CLI, TUI, Web UI, Browser, OCR, models, and first-party Programs.
    - This release does not publish a Linux Desktop package. The complete CLI/server runtime provides both the Web UI and TUI.
  - **Development installation**
    - Follow the [development installation guide](https://openprogram.io/docs/install/install.html) to install from source.
    - Development installation adds source editing, debugging, testing, and replaceable OCR/Browser backends to the complete product capabilities.

- **Windows**
  - **Browser access**
    - Windows users can access an OpenProgram instance hosted on macOS or Linux through a browser without installing OpenProgram locally.
  - This release does not include a native Windows installer. The runtime/Desktop separation preserves the option to add one in a later release.

The wheel and source distribution attached to this Release are developer artifacts, not complete ordinary-user installation paths.

## 🔄 Upgrade guide

- **First CLI/server installation:** run `curl -fsSL https://openprogram.io/install | sh`.
- **CLI/server upgrade:** run the same command again; the installer switches versions only after the new version passes verification.
- **First macOS App installation:** download the DMG for the Mac's processor and copy OpenProgram to Applications.
- **macOS App upgrade:** download the DMG for the new version and replace the existing App. User data in `~/.openprogram` remains unchanged.
- **Show the installed version:** run `openprogram --version`.
- **Check installation health:** run `openprogram doctor`.

## ✅ Complete capability set

- Managed CPython and OpenProgram runtime
- Web UI, CLI/TUI, Providers, MCP, Memory, Channels, and Search
- Playwright Chromium, default OCR data, and the GUI detector model
- First-party GUI, Research, and Wiki Programs

Ordinary-user installations do not clone the source repository, build the frontend locally, or resolve product dependencies from PyPI.

## 🔐 File verification

- macOS Desktop: use `SHA256SUMS-mac-arm64` or `SHA256SUMS-mac-x86_64`.
- macOS/Linux runtime: use the `.sha256` file beside the corresponding archive.
- Complete asset inventory: [release-manifest.json](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/download/v0.6.6/release-manifest.json)

See the [installation documentation](https://openprogram.io/docs/install/install.html) and the [v0.6.6 commit history](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/commits/v0.6.6) for more information.
